translations.web: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full.”
translations.bsb: Then go inside, shut the door behind you and your sons, and pour oil into all these jars, setting the full ones aside.”
translations.kjv: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
translations.asv: And thou shalt go in, and shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and pour out into all those vessels; and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
